question: Which region had the highest refund rate in 2025, and within that region which sales channel had the most refunded orders? Give the region, the channel and the number of refunded orders.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH region_refunds AS (SELECT r.region_name, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS refund_rate FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON c.region_id = r.region_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_name ORDER BY refund_rate DESC LIMIT 1), top_region AS (SELECT region_name FROM region_refunds) SELECT tr.region_name AS region, o.channel AS channel, COUNT(*) AS refunded_orders FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON c.region_id = r.region_id JOIN top_region AS tr ON r.region_name = tr.region_name WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status = 'refunded' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY refunded_orders DESC LIMIT 1
